tools.name: hs_deck_check
tools.description: FREE Hearthstone deck check: deck codes, Standard/Wild, copies, class. Paste a deck code (AAECA...) or the exported list. Decodes it and checks 30 cards (40 with Prince Renathal), max 2 copies / 1 Legendary, class cards, Standard sets for the current year; returns curve and card list. Data: Hearthst

tools.name: hs_opening_hand_odds
tools.description: FREE Hearthstone opening hand odds for one card. Chance a card you run 1 or 2 copies of is in your opening hand (3 cards going first, 4 going second), before mulligan. (free, no payment)

tools.name: hs_draw_odds
tools.description: FREE Hearthstone draw sim: exact odds to draw your cards by turn N. Exact joint odds (no mulligan) of drawing one or more cards (up to 6 groups) by each turn, going first (3 cards) or second (4 cards). (free, no payment)

tools.name: hs_mulligan_odds
tools.description: FREE Hearthstone mulligan sim: odds to find key cards with a mulligan. Seeded simulation of the Hearthstone mulligan (replacements never include the tossed cards) for up to 4 key cards: odds in the opening hand and by turn N, versus no mulligan. (free, no payment)

tools.name: hs_curve_goldfish
tools.description: FREE Hearthstone curve goldfish simulator for a deck code. Seeded Monte Carlo goldfish: mulligan, draws, mana each turn, The Coin going second, best mana use per turn (exact subset search), and your goals ("play Techysaurus by turn 7"). Up to 20,000 games. (free, no payment)
